R&B Singer Freddie Jackson Dies at 70

Grammy-nominated R&B singer Freddie Jackson, known for his 1980s hits such as 'You Are My Lady' and 'Rock Me Tonight,' has died at the age of 70. He was a fixture of 80s R&B music.
